messages:
Anya: Heads up — just hit a nasty gust on the Bay Bridge while biking into work. Bike wobbled, saw a couple of e-scooters wobble too. Caltrans tweeted an advisory: https://twitter.com/CaltransD4/status/1234567890

Mike: Thanks! Driving over from Oakland now, traffic looks slow on 80 inbound, probably the gusts + backups.

Jess: Yikes. Took BART to Embarcadero, train's fine but walking from the station is...stormy. :umbrella:

Sam: Riding 24 this morning. Wipers on full. Saw a tow on the right shoulder by Fruitvale. No big delays yet.

Marco: @Anya wild — glad you're okay. FYI, I left an extra pair of shoes near the front desk if anyone needs dry ones.

Anya: @Marco champion. Will swing by later :pray:

TransitBot: [ALERT] AC Transit: 800/801 experiencing minor delays between Fruitvale and Downtown Oakland due to high winds. https://status.actransit.org

Jess: Quick poll — who's commuting by: a) driving b) transit c) bike/scooter d) WFH? Reply with the letter.

Mike: a

Sam: b

Anya: c

Marco: a (carpooling)

Jess: b

Anya: Also, pro tip — when the bridge gets gusty, sit a bit back and don't stand up on pedals. Learned it the hard way :sweat_smile:

Sam: Video from the bridge — tiny wobble but then sorted: https://imgur.com/example

Mike: ETA update: 15–20 extra mins on 80

Jess: Office folks — if you need a lift from Embarcadero to SOMA, ping me, I have space in my car at 10:30.

Anya: Thanks everyone. If traffic gets worse I'll switch to transit. Appreciate the check-ins :heart:

(Reaction summary: :thumbsup: x6, :umbrella: x2)
